BasePK: 2587260
Chunk index: 3

Speech chunk:
I must draw to the attention of the government that they did not take into account some of their responsibilities. In the field of secondary industry, which is the basis of Canadian economy, this government has been totally powerless and inefficient. We are still awaiting an early announcement of a legislation to stimulate the development of secondary industry in Canada, which is threatened by a host of finished products from abroad. In fact, our market is now invaded by finished products, imported at prices lower than those found on the Canadian market but the government has presented no legislation that could protect our manufacturers. Unfortunately, Mr. Speaker, I realize that my time is up and I hope I will have the opportunity to get back to this matter.
